decision.observation: Only two duplicants remain after a death, and the starting chamber still lacks oxygen generation. A visibly bluer, oxygen-rich cavern lies directly above the pod, separated by sandstone and ore.
decision.hypothesis: Digging a vertical shaft upward beside the pod should release breathable oxygen into the chamber and expose useful ore.
decision.memory: One duplicant has died. Prior Outhouse placements were obstructed or unsupported; postpone sanitation and open a path to the oxygen-rich upper cavern immediately.
